title: Matchday Core
description: A four-image esports matchday system covering pre-match, live, score, and feature surfaces with one unified visual identity.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the event identity, team lineup styling, and broadcast mood. Images 02-04 keep that same matchday system across live and recap assets.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-pre-match-lineup-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-live-cover, 03-score-update-tile, 04-mvp-feature-card. Queue may run 02-live-cover, 03-score-update-tile, 04-mvp-feature-card concurrently after 01-pre-match-lineup-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
